source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current migration test records incoming and outgoing socket types before calling MailMigrator._migrateUI with version 43. It expects only value 1 to change to alwaysSTARTTLS. It checks the other values remain equal to their previous values. The registered unit test covers configuration migration, not a TLS handshake, certificate policy or a downgrade attack. The unused expectedSocketTypeAFter fixture field is not a naming example to adopt.
title: Test both changed and unchanged socket values in both server directions
